metadata.case_name: SO SUP NG v. CHUNG PO MOON CATOLE AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_after: salesman in uncle's trading company in Guangzhou (from October 2013); casual sailor in Macau for 8 days
plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: sedentary work such as car park attendant or security guard

injuries.description: segmental fracture shaft of right tibia
source: segmental fracture shaft of right tibia
X-ray showed fractured tibia at proximal and distal 1/3.
Fractured fibula at proximal 1/3 was also noted.
closed reduction and screw fixation to right medial malleolus
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the ankle or foot

injuries.description: Infection over right shin with abscess; right leg wound debridement and removal of implants from right tibia
source: Infection over right shin was detected on 3 December 2009.
Incision and drainage of right shin abscess was performed on 5 January 2010.
Incision and drainage of right leg abscess was performed on 9 June 2010.
Right leg wound debridement and removal of implants from right tibia was performed on 15 June 2010.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified open wound of knee or lower leg

manifestations.description: right leg pain and scar; right knee and ankle stiffness, weakness and numbness
residual right shin pain after walking for 30 minutes
some stiffness of dorsiflexion of right ankle
intermittent pain over right leg from knee to ankle reaching up to 6-9/10; worse at night 4-5 nights a week; needing analgesics on average every other day and 2-3 times each day when there was pain

treatments_received: surgical toileting and suturing of wounds
closed reduction and intramedullary nail fixation to right tibia
closed reduction and screw fixation to right medial malleolus
physiotherapy (24 sessions in Tuen Mun Hospital from December 2009 to July 2010)
occupational therapy (3 sessions in Tuen Mun Hospital from 13 April 2010 to 27 May 2010)
incision and drainage of right shin abscess (5 January 2010)
incision and drainage of right leg abscess (9 June 2010)
right leg wound debridement and removal of implants from right tibia (15 June 2010)
vocational rehabilitation referrals (10 March 2010 and 28 July 2010)

losses.description: Right leg, right knee and right ankle injuries resulting in (i) right leg pain and scar; (ii) right knee and ankle stiffness, weakness and numbness

Activities that caused increased physical demand on the right lower limb (eg prolonged standing and walking; prolonged squatting; walking a lot of stairs; running) would likely cause discomfort or even pain in the right lower limb (knee, leg or ankle).

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: He used to swim, play soccer and cycle. He was afraid and not confident to return to these sports after injury.

comparable_cases.case_name: Yau Kam Ching v. Cheung Shu Kau
comparable_cases.injury_description: Fracture left distal tibia and fibula and fracture left medial malleolus; small amount of left parietal traumatic subarachnoid haemorrhage
